title: Montgomery GI Bill and Chapter 35 Flat Monthly Benefit Rule
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 4 — The flat monthly benefit of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**4.01 Retired clause.** The clause "Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 pay the student a flat monthly rate by training time" is **no longer in force**; the basis on which the rate paid is selected has been superseded by the current basis. The remaining clauses of this part stay in force.

**4.02 Rates and proration (in force).** The rate paid is one of the tier's flat monthly rates — the full-time, three-quarter-time, half-time or less-than-half-time rate of the tier — prorated by the days of the month inside the term over a 30-day month. The less-than-half-time amount never exceeds the tuition and fees charged for the month.

**4.03 School (in force).** The school is paid nothing directly under these chapters.

**4.04 Release and pay day (in force).** A monthly payment is released only after the student has verified enrollment for that month, and it is paid on day 1 of the following month. The evidence of release is the system's record of a verification entry for the same certification and the same month as the payment.

**4.05 Proration illustration (hypothetical inputs).** A tier rate of $1259.00 for a month in which 15 days fall inside the term: $1259.00 multiplied by 15 and divided by 30 is $629.50. A month entirely inside the term is paid as 30 days of 30, the whole rate.

**4.06 Less-than-half-time ceiling (hypothetical).** Where the tier's less-than-half-time rate is $629.50 but the tuition and fees charged for the month are $400.00, the amount for the month is no more than $400.00.

**4.07 Pay-day illustration.** Training in March, verified, is paid on April 1.

superseded_clauses: Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 pay the student a flat monthly rate by training time
